notice: Phase 1 design artifact; not a running server or a runtime registration catalogue. Native ACL, state, URL origin and linkage checks remain mandatory.

tools.name: plane_list_workspaces
tools.description: List only selected workspaces still accessible to this connection owner.

tools.name: plane_list_containers
tools.description: List administrative projects and research chains; follow every returned cursor.

tools.name: plane_list_nodes
tools.description: List research nodes. Administrative projects return not_applicable and a task-list entry.

tools.name: plane_list_tasks
tools.description: List native tasks in their real parent; administrative Issue parent means immediate subtasks.

tools.name: plane_get_context
tools.description: Read one bounded context section. Use capabilities for editable fields, candidate assignees and transitions.

tools.name: plane_read_resource
tools.description: Read allowed bounded native content, never fetch URLs or file bytes. Formal reports require an explicit version.

tools.name: plane_create_task
tools.description: Create one administrative Issue directly. For research creation, prepare and execute a research proposal.

tools.name: plane_update_task
tools.description: Replace explicit editable fields directly; research lifecycle status and resource binding are separate operations.

tools.name: plane_add_comment
tools.description: Append one administrative comment directly. Research comments retain prepare/execute.

tools.name: plane_transition_task
tools.description: Use a native administrative state id or an explicitly permitted research task action; never set research status.

tools.name: plane_prepare_research_operation
tools.description: Prepare an immutable proposal with one closed action schema; no business mutation and no extra Plane approval.

tools.name: plane_execute_research_operation
tools.description: Execute the exact authorized proposal; after timeout query the same operation id.

tools.name: plane_get_research_operation
tools.description: Recover proposal and durable commit/readback result within live credential scope.

tools.name: plane_list_research_operations
tools.description: Find existing proposals by node and optionally request id; enables recovery after prepare timeout.

tools.name: plane_get_write_result
tools.description: Recover an administrative create/comment receipt; this lookup never executes a write.

updated_for_develop: 2026-10-29: native research tasks complete/reopen/cancel; report approvals are separate.
